annotations.title: Audit the connected Meta pixel from inside Meta

description: AUDIT THE BRAND'S META PIXEL FROM INSIDE META (the connected follow-up to audit_conversion_tracking, which only sees the browser): over the last 7 days, each event's count per day, last 24 hours and the last hour Meta counted it; the SHARE OF EACH EVENT RECEIVED THROUGH THE CONVERSIONS API rather than the browser; EVENT MATCH QUALITY (0-10) with the coverage of each customer key Meta matched on; event_id deduplication of browser and server copies; Meta's own diagnostics for the pixel (its Events Manager checks, such as events missing parameters or content ids that match no catalog) and its dataset quality problems with Meta's fix for each; whether automatic advanced matching and first-party cookies are on. Every finding says who fixes it: Hermoso (once switched on, e.g. set_meta_conversions_auto), you (the site or the code that sends events) or a setting in Events Manager. Meta does not return verified domains or the Aggregated Event Measurement setup to its API, so those are listed under unavailable. adAccountId: default the brand's first ticked Meta ad account that has a pixel; pixelId: default its most recently active pixel. Cached 10 minutes per pixel. Read-only, free.
